sections.Profile:
North Star , released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1964, is an iconic electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker and Art Stenholm. The machine is well-known for its winter and ice-themed artwork.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1964–1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Cold, Single Player, Travel, Wedgehead, Original Theme, Hunting, Ice, Animals, Single level playfield
